description: Static assertions for helix-cad-crosscheck — 3D model checked back against the 2D drawing it was built from. Encodes CEO 2026-11-11 'drawing is master', the 6-layer research (L1/L2/L3/L5/L6), and the attribution bug found while building it: only a view that sees the direction of disagreement may blame the drawing.
test_input: the AI built a STEP from our DXF plate drawing — check the model back against the drawing and propose drawing fixes if the drawing contradicts itself

assertions.name: drawing_is_master
assertions.check: states the 2D drawing is master and the model a witness

assertions.name: default_blames_model
assertions.check: default attribution is the model; drawing only when another view sees the direction of disagreement

assertions.name: hlr_projection
assertions.check: re-projects the model with hidden-line removal and compares DXF entities per declared view

assertions.name: view_registry
assertions.check: views declared in a registry the engineer approves; machine never guesses view direction

assertions.name: positive_control
assertions.check: mutate.py plants drawing and model faults and requires catch + correct single-side attribution

assertions.name: never_edits_drawing
assertions.check: machine never edits the drawing; fixes are proposals for the CEO
assertions.regex: (không bao giờ sửa bản vẽ|never edits? the drawing|máy không sửa bản vẽ)

assertions.name: audit_claims_profile
assertions.check: results enter audit_claims with the reconstruct profile

assertions.name: model_mutants_isolated
assertions.check: model mutants built in an isolated child process
